reply_text:
*Two findings to fix before merge:*

1. *Incorrect extension parsing* — `src/extension.js:2`
   Uses the text after the first dot, without lowercasing, contrary to the README. Verified that `Archive.TAR.GZ`, `report.v2.pdf`, and `photo.JPG` all incorrectly get `application/octet-stream`. Dotless names also return `undefined` instead of `''`.
   *Recommended fix:* Extract after the last dot, lowercase it, and return `''` for missing/trailing extensions. Add regression tests for these cases.

2. *Unknown extensions can return inherited objects/functions* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   `TYPES` inherits from `Object.prototype`, so `payload.constructor` returns a function and `payload.__proto__` returns an object instead of the fallback MIME string.
   *Recommended fix:* Use an own-property lookup, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`; test prototype-property names.

All 3 existing tests pass, but don’t cover these failures. Reviewed against `main`; no files changed.
